source_refs.note: Gas Laws: a main subheading of 6.1 Assumptions of the kinetic theory of gases, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 119-119.

blocks.text: Gas ki halat kuch variables (state functions) se bayan hoti hai: pressure, volume aur temperature (P, V aur T). Ek variable badlein aur teesra constant rakhein to doosra variable badalta hai. Ideal gas ke liye in variables ko aapas mein jorne wale laws gas laws kehlate hain.

Yeh law Robert Boyle ne 1662 mein diya. Yeh constant temperature par gas ke pressure aur volume ka rishta batata hai: ideal gas ke fixed mass ke liye constant temperature par pressure P volume V ke inversely proportional (ek barhe to doosra ghate) hai. Volume dugna karein to pressure aadha ho jata hai.
Boyle's law ka graph Fig. 6.1 mein hai.

blocks.alt: Pressure P (khari axis) aur volume V (pari axis) ka graph, origin 0. Magenta curve oopar (P1, V1) se tezi se girta hai aur daen taraf (P2, V2) ki taraf chapta hota jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.1: Boyle ka law (qaida) graph ki shakal mein (kitab ki Figure 6.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Constant temperature par volume V barhta hai to pressure P ghatta hai, is liye curve neeche aata hai. Curve ke har point par P × V ek hi hai: P₁V₁ = P₂V₂. Aise curve ko hyperbola kehte hain.

Charles' law constant pressure par ideal gas ke fixed mass ke volume aur temperature ka rishta hai. Yeh French physicist Jacques Charles ne diya. Is ke mutabiq constant pressure par gas ke diye gaye mass ka volume absolute temperature ke directly proportional hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke yeh law 1870 mein bana. Yeh durust nahi: Jacques Charles 1823 mein faut ho gaye the; unhon ne yeh law taqreeban 1787 mein maloom kiya aur Gay-Lussac ne 1802 mein chhapa.
Is ka graph Fig. 6.2 mein hai.

blocks.alt: Volume V aur temperature T ka graph. Magenta seedhi line daen taraf oopar jati hai; peeche baen taraf barhayein to yeh khari V axis ke baen taraf -273 °C par temperature axis se milti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.2: Charles ka law graph ki shakal mein (kitab ki Figure 6.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Is graph mein temperature °C mein hai. Line ko peeche barhayein to −273 °C par volume zero ho jata hai; yahi absolute zero (0 K) hai. Kelvin mein naapein to line origin se guzarti hai, yani V aur T directly proportional hain.
Ideal gas ke fixed mass ke liye constant volume par gas ka pressure us ke absolute temperature ke directly proportional hai.
Gay-Lussac's law ka graph Fig. 6.3 mein hai.

blocks.alt: Pressure P aur temperature T ka graph: origin se oopar jati seedhi line.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.3: Gay-Lussac ka law graph ki shakal mein (kitab ki Figure 6.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
